sql: select (select json_agg(x) from (select from_me, message_type, left(content, 160) c, to_char(timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo','HH24:MI:SS') t from public.wapi_messages where conversation_id = '8ebadb3b-dda6-4a3f-bab6-037a977bc754' and timestamp > now() - interval '50 minutes' order by timestamp) x) msgs, (select json_agg(y) from (select s.company_id, c.name, s.enabled, s.unit, s.test_mode_enabled, s.activated_at from public.ai_agent_settings s join public.companies c on c.id = s.company_id) y) ai, (select json_agg(z) from (select c.name, i.unit, i.id from public.wapi_instances i join public.companies c on c.id = i.company_id order by c.name, i.unit) z) inst
